_comment: NicheForge key-ladder config. Put ONE or more API keys per provider (comma-separated in setup_keys.py becomes this list). Enter to skip a provider keeps it disabled -- the ladder just skips providers with no keys. pollinations needs NO key. Get free keys: Google AI Studio (Gemini), console.groq.com (Groq), build.nvidia.com (NVIDIA NIM), openrouter.ai (OpenRouter), z.ai (Z.ai GLM). NEVER commit this file with real keys -- setup_keys.py stores it ENCRYPTED in config.json. browser_accounts: login emails per AI service for the Phase-3 browser track (multiple emails per service = rotation pool).
